title: How to get unusual animal poses when working from life?
content: After looking at yesterdays' video about painting a dog from life,Ellen Edgertonsaid, "Unfortunately for me when I keep an idealized animal form in my mind, the painting I end up with seems stiff and without spontaneity. What are some ways to overcome that?"Answer: I know what you mean. That happens to me, too. If you're painting them from life, you can start with a pencil or pen doodle sketchbook to notate the very quick gestures and weird poses and then you have those locked in to guide your painting.This videomight have a few more tips.
